$comment: Offline supporting asset for the Twin Interface inclusion mechanism described in proposal.md. The Gauge Equivalence Index (GEI) makes 'not using AI is not penalised' a countable commitment. Conceptual target; not a current service standard, procurement term, funding commitment, or government deadline.
title: Gauge Equivalence Index (GEI) — countable non-AI parity for every AI public scenario
title_zh: 轨距等价指数 GEI——每个 AI 公共场景的非 AI 等价可计数承诺

formula.const: GEI = w_c * coverage + w_a * accessibility + w_t * time_parity
formula.description: Weighted sum of three sub-indicators, each scored 0-1. Weights default w_c=0.4, w_a=0.3, w_t=0.3 and are set by professional teams at roll-out.

definition.const: share of AI public scenarios that have an equal, equally visible, equally reachable non-AI channel (staffed window, paper/audio guide, telephone service)
share of non-AI channels that are physically reachable and operable without a digital account, model, network or power dependency
share of non-AI channels that complete the same matter within a comparable service time as the AI channel (calibrated at pilot)

signage.description: 100% of AI public scenarios post a 'completable without AI' sign, verified item-by-item at roll-out.

no_ai_no_penalty.description: Anyone may request the same matter be handled without AI and must not be treated differently for declining to use AI.

per_station_fallback.description: One non-digital alternative service point per station (Zhongzhi / Origin / Dazhong).

disclaimer.const: Conceptual inclusion target for pilot calibration. Not a current service standard, procurement term, funding commitment, or government deadline. Specifics follow professional deepening and policy arrangements.

examples.formula: GEI = w_c * coverage + w_a * accessibility + w_t * time_parity

coverage.definition: share of AI public scenarios that have an equal, equally visible, equally reachable non-AI channel (staffed window, paper/audio guide, telephone service)

accessibility.definition: share of non-AI channels that are physically reachable and operable without a digital account, model, network or power dependency

time_parity.definition: share of non-AI channels that complete the same matter within a comparable service time as the AI channel (calibrated at pilot)
